name: Content - tab/accordion
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Content - tab/accordion.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Use short anchor links
settings.info: Keep anchor names unique across the page. Off preserves section-prefixed IDs.
settings.how: Turn on “Use short anchor links” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
